tool_args.rationale: The dual-horizon fit was refuted on fresh confirmation. The archive identifies a coupled 2-state memory ODE requiring four fitted parameters and recommends a fine trajectory batch; acquire it to distinguish this dynamic mechanism from sink-coupled static alternatives before resubmitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; it confirmed sign reversal but the submitted model failed fresh confirmation, so more horizon-only points are unlikely to resolve the remaining mechanism ambiguity.
The failed fit leaves these competing with dynamical explanations; the present data do not identify which stationary mechanism predicts new cases.
Confirmation failure alone is not evidence of high-frequency nonstationary chaos; the available trajectory batch can test the coupled-memory alternative.
